text: The 'sHoTT' library for Rzk formalises results in:
choices: synthetic ∞-category theory in Riehl-Shulman simplicial type theory
explanation: sHoTT (Kudasov et al.) is a Rzk library implementing the Yoneda lemma, adjunctions, and other results in Riehl-Shulman STT. It is a proof-of-concept for synthetic ∞-category theory.
